title: EIA Money
description: Canonical money value for every EIA API (SPEC 10.3 and 12.2). The amount is always a decimal string with at most four fraction digits and is never a JSON number; the currency is an ISO 4217 alpha-3 code. Zero is valid. A negative amount is permitted only for an explicit reversal, return, or credit field, never for an original payment. The flat amount/currency pairs used by the current vertical payloads (premiumAmount/premiumCurrency, reserveAmount/reserveCurrency) are documented in each vertical schema and must migrate to this object; see MISMATCHES.md.

MoneyAmount.description: Decimal amount as a string with at most four fraction digits, for example 1250000.00. Never a JSON number.
